scope: Accepted 1858 batches 04–05 and forwarded de Vriese/Wallace supplements only; source-rendering, attribution, chronology and provenance requirements. No converter, transcript, corpus, training, export or accepted-evidence changes.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the literal reverse question mark and following uncertain punctuation in the Audubon/heron seed query. It is a manuscript-text artifact and must not be silently normalized into a standard question or treated as editorial prose.

evidence.quote: He found its seeds in stomach of Heron. [reverse question mark] from digested Fish.?-?.?-?.

requirements.requirement: Retain the source’s literal comparison wording and capitalization distinctions where present in the accepted reading: Darwin’s MORE claim must remain distinct from Hooker’s reported LESS assessment. Do not flatten the disagreement into a single modern paraphrase.

evidence.quote: I do not think I said that I thought the productions of Asia were higher than those of Australia.

requirements.requirement: Render Murray’s financial offer with the actual two-thirds MathML fraction, while retaining unfilled copyist placeholders and the separate handwritten signature. The fraction is source markup, not the flattened “23” artifact.

evidence.quote: I shall be quite willing to give the author 12 copies for himself & as many more as he may require at the trade price

requirements.requirement: Keep Darwin’s body wording “heavy loss” and “0-scientific men” exactly as transmitted, with editorial footnote correction/conjecture in research provenance only. The body’s apparent contradiction is not permission to rewrite it to “against” or “non-scientific”.

evidence.quote: enough to ensure heavy loss amongst scientific & semi-scientific men

requirements.requirement: Represent the three enclosure groups separately: Darwin’s cover discussion, Haughton’s quoted criticism, Darwin’s uncorrected reversion expansion, and the returned/read Gray material. Do not expand the absent manuscript or attribute Haughton’s words to Darwin.

evidence.quote: I enclose a criticism,—. a taste of the future.—

requirements.requirement: Mark the mid-letter Gray material as a later receipt/use section. Darwin says he has received and is interested in Gray’s note after composing the preceding discussion; preserve this internal chronology and do not apply Gray’s claims to the whole letter.

evidence.quote: Since the above was written I have received & been much interested by A. Gray.

requirements.requirement: Keep the recovered French original, its modern translation and the pinned metadata as separate provenance layers. Preserve bracketed lacunae and diacritics in the French body; do not export a fabricated Darwin-language paraphrase or silently merge the translation into de Vriese’s voice. The promised later special notes remain unlocated.

evidence.locator: external HTML; first substantive French body paragraph under #letter
evidence.quote: Pour repondre à la question de M. Darwin, sur quelle hauteur végétent les plantes perennantes d’environ la latitude de la Grande Bretagne, je dirai ce que j’en ai vu.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Wallace’s 6 October 1858 letter to Hooker as third-party correspondence. Its gratitude for the handling of Wallace’s and Darwin’s papers and concern about publication credit must not be emitted as Darwin voice or counted as a Darwin receipt/prompt without a separate admitted endpoint.

evidence.locator: external HTML; substantive body paragraph under #letter
evidence.quote: It would have caused me much pain & regret had Mr. Darwin’s excess of generosity led him to make public my paper unaccompanied by his own much earlier

implementation_boundary.allowed: Document rendering/provenance requirements for later root review.

notes: All body paragraph numbers are retained corpus numbering; DOM locators are independent anchors. Accepted relationships remain primary decisions.
